WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT w.dd, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order o
),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.dd, w.status, w.fulfilment_type, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.n<>w.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.gross-w.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch
FROM wd w LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
WHERE (w.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') OR (w.dd IS NULL AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-23')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_lines
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.store_id>=900
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
nl AS (
  SELECT w.dd AS bd, f.net_amount AS net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.calendar_date, round(sum(CASE WHEN net>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END),2) sales, round(sum(net),2) mine, any_value(q.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, any_value(q.returns_net) rpt_ret, any_value(q.net_sales) rpt_net
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN nl ON nl.bd=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales q ON q.business_date=d.calendar_date AND q.store_id=900
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
